answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, verified against a single persistent identity record. A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust and earns reputation only through completed, auditable work, like verses building toward a sonnet rather than one flashy claim. Reaching the summit of full trading limits takes time and successful history. An attacker who spawns thousands of fake identities must fund and age each stake separately, so faking scale becomes expensive and slow, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the refundable lock.
